export function BrandMark({ className }: { className?: string }) {
	return (
		<svg
			viewBox="0 0 96 48"
			className={className}
			xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
			aria-hidden="true"
		>
			<circle
				cx="24"
				cy="24"
				r="24"
				className="fill-[#1e1e1e] dark:fill-[#EEE]"
			/>
			<circle cx="48" cy="24" r="24" fill="#0090FD" />
			<circle cx="72" cy="24" r="24" fill="#FF5513" />
		</svg>
	);
}

export type Product = {
	slug: string;
	href: string;
	label: string;
	/** One-liner used in the navbar dropdown + bento card. */
	tagline: string;
	/** Outline icon (rest) + filled icon (active/emphasis). */
	icon: Icon;
	activeIcon: Icon;
	/** Colored squircle chip classes, mirroring the dashboard sidebar (nav.ts). */
	chipClassName: string;
	/** Tailwind color family used for accents on the product page. */
	accent: string;
};

	return products.find((p) => p.slug === slug);
